name: The Sixth Coat
description: Recover the last ferry ticket from the Drowned Tollhouse and decide what Bellwake owes its dead.

prologue.text: The night ferry returns with five passengers and six coats. Find Mira beside the landing at Bellwake Quay.

stages.name: Speak to Mira
stages.description: Find Mira beside the landing at Bellwake Quay and ask about the wet coat.

stages.name: Recover the last ticket
stages.description: Leave by the south landing and follow the marsh east to the Drowned Tollhouse. Defeat the Keeper and take Ada's ticket. Tor can help you prepare at the quay.

stages.name: Bring the ticket to Mira
stages.description: Return west to Bellwake Quay. Speak to Mira and decide how Ada's crossing ends.
